description: Plataforma Nacional de Datos Abiertos (Peru) is a data repository run by Plataforma Nacional de Datos Abiertos del Perú, found in the Americas country search of 2026-09-30. Searchable catalogue of public-sector data of Peru with about 4,663 datasets and 17,168 resources across more than 20 categories in CSV, XLSX, JSON and other formats. Coverage: Perú. The homepage answered on 2026-09-30; its title reads "Plataforma Nacional de Datos Abiertos". Text above taken from the homepage (page summary); the data pages behind it were not opened. It is reached through the link recorded on this page. Access to the repository is free of charge and open; individual data sets may carry their own conditions. The licence is set per dataset in the repository (not stated on the homepage). Caveats: only the homepage was read, so the data sets behind it, their formats, their licences and their current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of Perú.
